popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Erginus of Miletus, son of Poseidon, sails with Jason — numbered among the Argonauts skilled in seacraft. Distinct from Erginus the Minyan king of Orchomenus.

popCulture.title: Erginus (Argonaut)
popCulture.description: Milesian Argonaut son of Poseidon — not the Orchomenian king who taxed Thebes.
